create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a graph with start and accept nodes, then add arcs with labels and weights
build_scalar_graph: build a scalar graph from a single weight value for quick two-node graph creation
test_graph_arithmetic_with_autograd: test adding and subtracting graphs then run backward to compute gradients on arc weights
compare_graphs_for_equality_and_isomorph: compare two graphs for exact equality and structural isomorphism using gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic
run_parallel_operations_on_graph_lists: run negate and add operations in parallel across lists of graphs using gtn.parallel_for
